Reminder: Study Loan ApplicationsStudents who wish to apply for the National Study Loan are reminded to:
submit all required documents before 15 March.
ensure that forms are completed accurately.Incomplete or late applications will not be accepted or reviewed. Students who need help with the process have to visit the counselling office for guidance. This study loan provides financial support for further studies, so interested students should submit their applications before the closing date.
